destinations.name: Goa
destinations.bestTimeToVisit: November to February (pleasant, peak season). March–May is hot; June–September is monsoon with rough seas and many water sports closed.

destinations.name: Kerala
destinations.bestTimeToVisit: September to March (pleasant weather, best for houseboats and hill stations). June–August is monsoon – green and cheaper but rainy. April–May is hot and humid on the coast.

destinations.name: Himachal Pradesh
destinations.bestTimeToVisit: March to June (pleasant, sightseeing) and October to February (snow likely from December–February). July–September is monsoon with landslide risk.

destinations.name: Kashmir
destinations.bestTimeToVisit: April to June (gardens and tulips in early April, pleasant weather) and September–October (autumn colours). December to February for snow at Gulmarg (very cold).

destinations.name: Rajasthan
destinations.bestTimeToVisit: October to March (pleasant days, cool nights). April–June is very hot; July–September is monsoon (Udaipur lakes look best after the rains).

destinations.name: Uttarakhand
destinations.bestTimeToVisit: March to June and September to November. December–February is cold with snow at Auli, Dhanaulti and sometimes Nainital/Mussoorie. July–August is monsoon with landslide risk.

destinations.name: Maharashtra
destinations.bestTimeToVisit: June to September for monsoon greenery and waterfalls (Lonavala, Mahabaleshwar – some points close in heavy rain); October to February for pleasant weather. Strawberry season at Mahabaleshwar: roughly December–April.

destinations.name: Pilgrimage Tours
destinations.bestTimeToVisit: All year. October to March is most comfortable; Thursdays, weekends and Guru Purnima / Ram Navami / Dussehra are very crowded.

destinations.name: Ladakh
destinations.bestTimeToVisit: May to September (roads open, pleasant days). October–April is extremely cold; many passes and camps close.

destinations.name: Andaman Islands
destinations.bestTimeToVisit: October to May (calm seas, best for beaches and water sports). June–September is monsoon with rough seas and ferry cancellations.

destinations.name: North East India
destinations.bestTimeToVisit: March to May and October to December (clear Kanchenjunga views). Monsoon (June–September) has landslide risk.

destinations.name: Golden Triangle
destinations.bestTimeToVisit: October to March (pleasant). April–June is very hot; fog in late December–January can delay early drives.

destinations.name: Karnataka
destinations.bestTimeToVisit: October to March. Coorg is lush in monsoon (June–September) but waterfalls and roads can be slippery. Mysuru Dasara (Sept/Oct) is spectacular but crowded.

destinations.name: Tamil Nadu
destinations.bestTimeToVisit: March to June (summer escape) and September to November. December–February is cold at night.

destinations.name: Gujarat
destinations.bestTimeToVisit: October to March. Janmashtami at Dwarka and Mahashivratri at Somnath are very crowded.

destinations.name: Madhya Pradesh
destinations.bestTimeToVisit: October to March. Khajuraho Dance Festival is usually in February.

destinations.name: Varanasi
destinations.bestTimeToVisit: October to March. Dev Deepawali (Kartik Purnima, Nov) is spectacular but very crowded.

destinations.name: Dubai
destinations.bestTimeToVisit: November to March (pleasant 20–30°C; Dubai Shopping Festival usually Dec–Jan). June–September is extremely hot.

destinations.name: Maldives
destinations.bestTimeToVisit: November to April (dry season, calm seas, best visibility). May–October is the wet season with occasional rain – lower prices.

destinations.name: Thailand
destinations.bestTimeToVisit: November to March (cool and dry). April–May is very hot; June–October is the rainy season (Andaman-side islands like Phi Phi can have rough seas).

destinations.name: Bali
destinations.bestTimeToVisit: April to October (dry season). November–March is the wet season with afternoon showers (cheaper). Nyepi (Balinese Day of Silence, usually March) closes the island for a day.

destinations.name: Singapore
destinations.bestTimeToVisit: All year (tropical). February–April is driest; November–January is wetter. Great Singapore Sale usually mid-year.

destinations.name: Malaysia
destinations.bestTimeToVisit: December to April (west coast & Langkawi driest). May–October brings some rain on the west coast.

destinations.name: Sri Lanka
destinations.bestTimeToVisit: December to April for the west and south coast and hill country. May–September suits the east coast. Hill country (Nuwara Eliya) is cool all year.

destinations.name: Vietnam
destinations.bestTimeToVisit: North (Hanoi, Ha Long): October–April (cool winters Dec–Feb). Central (Da Nang, Hoi An): February–August; avoid Oct–Nov typhoon/flood season. South (Ho Chi Minh City): December–April dry.

destinations.name: Nepal
destinations.bestTimeToVisit: October to November and March to May (clear mountain views). December–February is cold but clear; June–September is monsoon with cloudy views.

destinations.name: Bhutan
destinations.bestTimeToVisit: March to May (rhododendrons, clear skies) and September to November (festivals, best views). Winter is cold but clear; June–August is monsoon.

destinations.name: Europe
destinations.bestTimeToVisit: April to October (long days; June–August is peak and most expensive). December has Christmas markets; winter suits snow trips in Switzerland.

destinations.name: United Kingdom
destinations.bestTimeToVisit: May to September (mild, long days). December has festive lights; winter is cold and dark early.

destinations.name: Australia
destinations.bestTimeToVisit: September to November and March to May (mild). December–February is hot summer; June–August is winter in Sydney.

destinations.name: Japan
destinations.bestTimeToVisit: Late March–early April (cherry blossoms) and October–November (autumn colours) – both peak and pricey. Summer is hot and humid; winter is cold but clear.

destinations.name: Mauritius
destinations.bestTimeToVisit: May to December (dry, pleasant). January–March is hot and humid with cyclone risk.

destinations.name: Turkey
destinations.bestTimeToVisit: April to June and September to November. July–August is hot and crowded; winter is cold (snow in Cappadocia).

destinations.name: USA
destinations.bestTimeToVisit: April to June and September to October. Winter is very cold; Niagara boat rides stop in winter.
